kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi create-report-definition --report-source-type OSS --report-type consumeDetailBillV2 --begin-billing-cycle 2025-05 --oss-bucket-owner-account-id 1234567812345678 --oss-bucket-name sh-bill --oss-bucket-path bill/ --mc-project project --mc-table-name table --nbid 2684201000001 --split-file-on-user-id true --not-send-on-no-data true --send-with-attach true --include-members true --api-version 2023-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateReportDefinition

parameters.help_en: The subscription source. Valid values: OSS, MC, and MSC_EMAIL
parameters.name: report_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:
consumeDetailBillV2: consumption details. This value is supported only by OSS/MC subscriptions.
splitDetailBillV2: split details. This value is supported only by OSS/MC subscriptions.
costDetailBillV2: cost details. This value is supported only by OSS/MC subscriptions.
monthBillOverview: monthly bill overview. This value is supported only by OSS/MSC_EMAIL subscriptions.
focus: FOCUS bill. This value is supported only by OSS/MC subscriptions
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型。取值类型：
consumeDetailBillV2：消费明细（仅OSS/MC订阅支持）。
splitDetailBillV2：分拆明细（仅OSS/MC订阅支持）。
costDetailBillV2：成本明细（仅OSS/MC订阅支持）。
monthBillOverview：月账单汇总（仅OSS/MSC_EMAIL订阅支持）。
focus：focus账单（仅OSS/MC订阅支持）
parameters.name: report_type

parameters.help_en: The start billing cycle for push. After the subscription succeeds, the system automatically pushes data from the start billing cycle to the current time. This parameter is invalid for monthly bill PDF subscriptions, and historical data will not be re-pushed. You can push data within the last year
parameters.help_zh: 推送起始账期。订阅成功后，系统会自动推送起始账期到当前时间的数据。月账单PDF订阅时此参数无效，不会对历史数据重新推送。最多可推送最近1年内数据
parameters.name: begin_billing_cycle

parameters.help_en: The UID of the OSS bucket owner that stores the files. If this is a Bid/Reseller subscription and you need to push data to a sub-account's OSS, specify this parameter. The account must be a sub-account of the calling account, and the AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole permission must be granted to this account. Regular users do not need to specify this parameter. The default value is the calling account
parameters.help_zh: 存储文件的Oss Owner对应的UID。如果是Bid/ReSeller订阅，并需要推送到子账号的OSS上时指定，需要此账号为调用账号子账号，并对此账号授予AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole权限。 普通用户则无需指定，默认为调用账号
parameters.name: oss_bucket_owner_account_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket for file storage
parameters.name: oss_bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The storage path of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: oss_bucket_path

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project
parameters.name: mc_project

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute subscription table
parameters.name: mc_table_name

parameters.help_en: The first-level site ID. If this parameter is left empty, the site ID of the current user is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 一级售卖场ID，如果为空，默认使用当前用户所属的场ID填充
parameters.name: nbid

parameters.help_en: The email subscription configuration that specifies whether to split attachments by user ID
parameters.help_zh: 邮件订阅相关配置，按userId拆分附件
parameters.name: split_file_on_user_id

parameters.help_en: The email subscription configuration that specifies whether to skip sending emails when no bills are available
parameters.help_zh: 邮件订阅相关配置，无账单时不发送邮件
parameters.name: not_send_on_no_data

parameters.help_en: The email subscription configuration that specifies whether to send emails with bill attachments
parameters.help_zh: 邮件订阅相关配置，邮件携带账单附件
parameters.name: send_with_attach

parameters.help_en: The email subscription configuration that specifies whether to include multi-account members of the organization in bills
parameters.help_zh: 邮件订阅相关配置，账单包含企业多账号成员
parameters.name: include_members
